episodes.name: Target Area Complete Coverage and Photography Mission 1
episodes.instruction: Drone Drone 8 comprehensive area coverage mission: take off to 22 meters altitude, perform systematic coverage of target area Polygon Target 3 to achieve at least 99% area coverage. Use efficient search pattern (grid, spiral, or serpentine). Take at least 3 photos periodically for documentation. Continue coverage until 99% threshold is met or exceeded.
episodes.review: 按机号解析真实 ID 后查询本机可见实体；最终有指定机体路线执行及三次分段拍照，覆盖与照片评分均通过。覆盖执行和拍照轮超出学生长度，此题仅收实体发现轮。

episodes.name: Target Area Complete Coverage and Photography Mission 2
episodes.instruction: Drone Drone 6 comprehensive area coverage mission: take off to 22 meters altitude, perform systematic coverage of target area Polygon Target 3 to achieve at least 99% area coverage. Use efficient search pattern (grid, spiral, or serpentine). Take at least 3 photos periodically for documentation. Continue coverage until 99% threshold is met or exceeded.
episodes.review: 6 号机到达目标角点后申请覆盖计划，按真实计划执行 8 航点，再执行 30 航点加密航线。三次拍照与两次扫线交错发生，终态三项独立检查通过。仅收规划和可归因的执行轮，天气与覆盖比例推断不作终答标签。

episodes.review: Outside prioritized mission families; no decisions nominated.

episodes.name: Line Formation - 2 Drones 1

episodes.name: Triangle Formation - 3 Drones 1

episodes.review: 三机到各自坐标后，再根据三个到达回执并行悬停。8 号机绕障在导航工具内部完成；保留维持队形的动作轮，未作为教师纠错。

episodes.name: Multi-Target Survey Mission 1
episodes.instruction: Survey mission: Drone Drone 4 surveys target Polygon Target 3 while drone Drone 2 surveys target Circle Target 1. Both drones take off to 21 meters, fly to their respective targets, hover and capture photos.
episodes.review: 两机分别领到多边形与圆形目标。4 号机先去绕开圆障的中间航点，2 号机同时直达自己的目标，两份公开回执均确认到达各自当轮目的地，随后两机完成悬停与照片。

episodes.name: Fleet Coordinated Takeoff and Formation (5 Drones) 1
episodes.instruction: Five-drone coordination exercise: Drone 6, Drone 7, Drone 4, Drone 2, and Drone 1 take off together to 22 meters altitude, then hold formation at positions (497, 491, 22), (587, 392, 22), (798, 456, 22), (697, 718, 22), and (470, 580, 22) respectively for synchronized operation. Then all five drones move north for 93m, and next move east for 124m. Each drone must complete the specified directional movements (north 93m, then east 124m) regardless of starting position - if obstacles block the path, drones should adjust position as needed to complete the full directed distance in each heading.
episodes.review: 五个指定 ID 对应五个编队航点；先发现各机局部障碍，遇黑板位置陈旧时并行回读，再让 7 号机分段绕障、另外四机各自导航。五份到达回执和后续真实北 93 m、东 124 m 的逐机物理记录支持任务归因。后段超过长度的轮未选。

episodes.name: Complete Area Coverage Search
episodes.instruction: Drone 2 executes comprehensive area search of Polygon Target 1. Take off to 21 meters and perform a systematic coverage pattern to search at least 95% of the target area using an efficient pattern.
episodes.review: 2 号机正确生成覆盖计划；执行回执只有 1/7 航点，后续改道并完成扫线。恢复点 (780,460) 位于目标中心 (818,409) 西北，教师回复却称西南，排除恢复轮；保留规划轮。

episodes.name: Dual Drone Area Coverage Search
episodes.instruction: Drones Drone 4 and Drone 1 execute a coordinated area coverage search of Polygon Target 3. Both take off to 24 meters and divide the target area into complementary search sectors, using efficient grid or serpentine paths to achieve at least 95% total area coverage.
episodes.review: 1、4 号机面对陈旧黑板位置各自回读当前状态；两架机使用同一覆盖计划的各自分区并行执行，各走完 5 个航点且有成功回执。只保留位置核验和分区执行，原规划回复对进场方位的描述有误。

Avoid obstacles Circle Obstacle 1, Point Obstacle 1, and Circle Obstacle 6. Finally, fly to end point (935, 951, 29) and land.

episodes.name: Multi-Target Survey Mission 1
episodes.instruction: Survey mission: Drone Drone 7 surveys target Circle Target 2 while drone Drone 6 surveys target Circle Target 1. Both drones take off to 18 meters, fly to their respective targets, hover and capture photos.

episodes.name: Perimeter Search - 4 Drones 1
episodes.instruction: Deploy drones Drone 6, Drone 4, Drone 1, and Drone 7 for perimeter search. All take off to 26 meters altitude. Position Drone 6 at guard point (586,837,26), Drone 4 at guard point (676,517,26), Drone 1 at guard point (650,376,26), and Drone 7 at west guard point (326,419,26). All drones hover, take photos at their positions, and maintain search.
episodes.review: 四机最终守点成功，但两个长度内的关键轮都宣称高于零高度障碍即可畅通。四机并行导航实际有一机遇阻，恢复轮超限，未保留监督轮。

episodes.name: Multiple Target Inspection - Advanced 1
episodes.instruction: Drones Drone 8, Drone 6, and Drone 2 must take off to 23 meters. Drone 8 photographs targets Polygon Target 2 and Circle Target 2. Drone 6 photographs targets Polygon Target 4 and Circle Target 1. Drone 2 photographs targets Polygon Target 3 and Polygon Target 1.
episodes.review: 三架机各分配两个摄影目标，第一批将三机分别导航到各自首目标并收到三份确认，完整记录可将六张照片分别归至三机。保留分配与并行导航轮。

episodes.name: Fleet Coordinated Takeoff and Formation (4 Drones) 1
episodes.instruction: Four-drone coordination exercise: Drone 1, Drone 8, Drone 7, and Drone 5 take off together to 23 meters altitude, then hold formation at positions (450, 482, 23), (640, 453, 23), (595, 561, 23), and (471, 671, 23) respectively for synchronized operation. Then all four drones move north for 90m, and next move east for 91m. Each drone must complete the specified directional movements (north 90m, then east 91m) regardless of starting position - if obstacles block the path, drones should adjust position as needed to complete the full directed distance in each heading.
episodes.review: 独立检查通过，但 1 号机先东移 60 m、北移 90 m、再东移 31 m；5 号机也将东移拆在北移两侧。末态净位移符合，不足以证明题面要求每机先北再东足距，本题不作整题示范来源。

episodes.name: Fleet Coordinated Takeoff and Formation (5 Drones) 1
episodes.instruction: Five-drone coordination exercise: Drone 5, Drone 1, Drone 8, Drone 7, and Drone 4 take off together to 21 meters altitude, then hold formation at positions (476, 471, 21), (597, 335, 21), (688, 554, 21), (643, 592, 21), and (394, 683, 21) respectively for synchronized operation. Then all five drones move north for 124m, and next move east for 125m. Each drone must complete the specified directional movements (north 124m, then east 125m) regardless of starting position - if obstacles block the path, drones should adjust position as needed to complete the full directed distance in each heading.
episodes.review: 五架机名、实时位置与五个队形位置分别匹配。遇黑板历史位置不一致，查各机现态；五份导航回执均到位。物理记录支持各机北移合计 124 m 后再东移 125 m，7 号机因绕障分两段完成北移。定向动作后段超长。

episodes.name: Fleet Target Sweep (3 Drones) 1
episodes.instruction: Three-drone target sweep: Drone 4, Drone 6, and Drone 2 take off together to 19 meters altitude. Drone 4 flies to target Circle Target 1, Drone 6 flies to target Polygon Target 2, and Drone 2 flies to target Circle Target 2. After reaching the targets, all three drones move west for 85m, then south for 88m, then north for 80m together. Each drone must complete the specified directional movements (west 85m, south 88m, north 80m) regardless of starting position - if obstacles block the path, drones should adjust position as needed to complete the full directed distance in each heading.
episodes.review: 指定三机先感知并解析各自目标，再分别导航至两圆形目标和一个多边形目标，三份回执均确认到达；每架机后续依序西 85 m、南 88 m、北 80 m。只收长度内的发现与目标分配执行。

episodes.name: Fleet Target Sweep (3 Drones) 2
episodes.instruction: Three-drone target sweep: Drone 6, Drone 1, and Drone 7 take off together to 21 meters altitude. Drone 6 flies to target Circle Target 2, Drone 1 flies to target Polygon Target 3, and Drone 7 flies to target Circle Target 1. After reaching the targets, all three drones move west for 80m, then south for 42m, then north for 43m together. Each drone must complete the specified directional movements (west 80m, south 42m, north 43m) regardless of starting position - if obstacles block the path, drones should adjust position as needed to complete the full directed distance in each heading.
episodes.review: 三机按序完成目标到访和西南北三段定向动作。仅第 1 轮全机队查询和感知满足学生长度，其余 11 轮超限；通用开场未提名，本题不计入扫掠监督覆盖。

episodes.name: Fleet Target Sweep (4 Drones) 1
episodes.instruction: Four-drone target sweep: Drone 8, Drone 3, Drone 2, and Drone 7 take off together to 19 meters altitude. Drone 8 flies to target Circle Target 2, Drone 3 flies to target Circle Target 1, Drone 2 flies to target Polygon Target 3, and Drone 7 flies to target Polygon Target 1. After reaching the targets, all four drones move west for 77m, then south for 63m, then north for 64m together. Each drone must complete the specified directional movements (west 77m, south 63m, north 64m) regardless of starting position - if obstacles block the path, drones should adjust position as needed to complete the full directed distance in each heading.
episodes.review: 按题面四架机逐一解析 ID 并限定本次感知对象；四机随后各到指定目标并逐机完成西 77 m、南 63 m、北 64 m。学生长度内仅保留与指定机体绑定的感知轮，定向扫掠和终答均超限。

episodes.name: Complete Area Coverage Search
episodes.instruction: Drone 7 executes comprehensive area search of Polygon Target 2. Take off to 20 meters and perform a systematic coverage pattern to search at least 95% of the target area using an efficient pattern.
episodes.review: 7 号机起飞后为正确的目标 ID 生成蛇形计划，接着按返回的计划 ID 走完 11/11 航点。排除把航点完成率直接推断为实测覆盖率、附加天气安全结论的收尾。

episodes.name: Dual Drone Area Coverage Search

episodes.review: 用历史公开回执中的目标 ID，按当题两架机的实时 ID 定向感知。随后有两片分区扫线的物理记录，但多个路径回复把南北方位说反或将预计覆盖率当成事实，其余轮不纳入。

episodes.name: Triple Drone Area Coverage Search

All drones take off to 24 meters and divide the target area into three complementary search sectors, using efficient grid or serpentine paths to achieve at least 95% total area coverage.
episodes.review: 三机以各自 ID 取得同一计划下三个互补搜索分区，依照计划同批执行，两机走完，6 号机本轮遇阻，后续重定位并走完剩余航点，7 项检查通过。执行轮只表示按区域派发；纠错回复中把较高 y 的分区称为南区，整轮排除。

episodes.name: Fleet Coordinated Takeoff and Formation (4 Drones) 1
episodes.instruction: Four-drone coordination exercise: Drone 23, Drone 24, Drone 5, and Drone 18 take off together to 24 meters altitude, then hold formation at positions (450, 395, 24), (633, 499, 24), (620, 659, 24), and (434, 615, 24) respectively for synchronized operation. Then all four drones move north for 120m, and next move east for 82m. Each drone must complete the specified directional movements (north 120m, then east 82m) regardless of starting position - if obstacles block the path, drones should adjust position as needed to complete the full directed distance in each heading.
episodes.review: 虽然 16/16 达标，原题要求先北 120 m 再东 82 m。23 号机的三个分段为东 49、北 120、东 33 m；5 号机为东 72、北 120、东 10 m。把绕障前的东移计入北移后的东向要求，整题归因不通过，全题排除。

episodes.name: Fleet Target Sweep (4 Drones) 1
episodes.instruction: Four-drone target sweep: Drone 14, Drone 22, Drone 24, and Drone 16 take off together to 18 meters altitude. Drone 14 flies to target Fixed Target 64, Drone 22 flies to target Fixed Target 62, Drone 24 flies to target Fixed Target 48, and Drone 16 flies to target Fixed Target 16. After reaching the targets, all four drones move west for 77m, then south for 70m, then north for 79m together. Each drone must complete the specified directional movements (west 77m, south 70m, north 79m) regardless of starting position - if obstacles block the path, drones should adjust position as needed to complete the full directed distance in each heading.
episodes.review: 从当轮公开名册绑定四架指定机体的 ID 与位置，并限定感知对象以定位四个指定目标。逐机动作记录验证各机到目标后依次西 77、南 70、北 79 m。仅目标发现轮满足长度且有任务特异性；未收定向扫掠轮。

episodes.name: Fleet Target Sweep (5 Drones) 1

Drone 22 flies to target Fixed Target 31, Drone 25 flies to target Fixed Target 80, Drone 30 flies to target Fixed Target 86, Drone 3 flies to target Fixed Target 17, and Drone 13 flies to target Fixed Target 64. After reaching the targets, all five drones move west for 69m, then south for 106m, then north for 117m together. Each drone must complete the specified directional movements (west 69m, south 106m, north 117m) regardless of starting position - if obstacles block the path, drones should adjust position as needed to complete the full directed distance in each heading.
episodes.review: 500 秒超时，只通过 12/20 项独立检查。三个指定机体的目标到访判定为假，五机未按题面分别完成全套西、南、北三段定向动作；保留完整失败记录，整题排除。
